answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 35154 Country: India Title: I am working in a MNC company who provide me the phone allowance 200 riyal for each month but after the Question: I am working in a MNC company who provide me the phone allowance 200 riyal for each month but after the completion of the month I have some amount remaining in my account. Is this amount halal or haram for me to use on myself? Answer ID: 35154 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1788/1260/L=1432) If the said company gives it to you without the condition of return in case the money remains, then whatever amount remains after passage of the month, it shall be lawful for you to use. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
